# Constants
TESTS = [
    ([1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 1, 2], [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9]),
    ([], []),
    ([1, 2, 3], [1, 2, 3])    
]

# Test
for original_list, expected_result in TESTS:
    result = list(original_list)
    clean_list(result)
    print(f"clean_list({original_list}) -> {result}")

Assignment #01.name: Cipher Function Testing
Assignment #01.code:
# Constants
TESTS = [
    ("Hello", 1, "IFMMP"),
    ("Goodbye", 2, "IQQFDAG"),
    ("David", 1, "EBWJE"),
    ("Test", 0, "TEST"),
    ("", 4, ""),
    ("Words, words and more words!", 5, "BTWIX, BTWIX FSI RTWJ BTWIX!"),
    ("one word two word red word blue word", 6, "UTK CUXJ ZCU CUXJ XKJ CUXJ HRAK CUXJ"),
    ('z', 1, 'A'),
    ('a', 1, 'B')
]

# Test
for text, n, expected_result in TESTS:
    result = shift(text, n)
    print(f"shift(\"{text}\", {n}) -> \"{result}\"")
    assert result == expected_result, f"Expected \"{expected_result}\" for `shift(\"{text}\", {n})` but got \"{result}\" instead"
